notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. A Dietetics program, approved by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, is offered as a Dietetic concentration within the Nutrition and Food major. To declare the Dietetics concentration, transfer students who are admitted to the university in the Nutrition and Food major must complete the following: Complete the following required core courses: BIO 10, CHEM 1A, CHEM 1B, NUFD 9, NUFD 10, NUDF 11, NUFD 113*, and STAT 1. All required core courses must be completed with a grade of "C" or higher. Only first or second attempts will be considered. Have an overall GPA of 2.75 Complete and submit a Major Change form to the Family and Consumer Sciences Department Office along with transcript copies of the above. *NUFD 113 is an upper-division course and must be completed at Sacramento State after transfer. For additional information, please visit: Department of Nutrition and Food .
notes.contentHtml:
1. Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. A Dietetics program, approved by the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, is offered as a Dietetic concentration within the Nutrition and Food major.
  3. To declare the Dietetics concentration, transfer students who are admitted to the university in the Nutrition and Food major must complete the following:
  4. Complete the following required core courses: BIO 10, CHEM 1A, CHEM 1B, NUFD 9, NUFD 10, NUDF 11, NUFD 113*, and STAT 1. All required core courses must be completed with a grade of "C" or higher. Only first or second attempts will be considered.
  5. Have an overall GPA of 2.75
  6. Complete and submit a Major Change form to the Family and Consumer Sciences Department Office along with transcript copies of the above.
  7. *NUFD 113 is an upper-division course and must be completed at Sacramento State after transfer.
  8. For additional information, please visit: Department of Nutrition and Food.
